manifest.sampling: each sample = mean ns/op over `batch` ops; percentiles are nearest-rank over samples (batch means, not single-op tails)
manifest.evidence_level: deterministic runtime shim (HIP labels); thread-safe fake driver; no GPU; host cost only

notes.fake_driver: cudaMalloc/cudaFree are malloc/free, events never block; driver latency excluded
notes.replay: per-thread seeded xorshift (seed 1000+tid); sequence deterministic, interleaving is not
notes.lock_wait: measured: std::recursive_mutex replaced by a timing drop-in (lock_wait_mutex.h); try_lock first, wait timed only when the lock was held
notes.scope: latency is not evidence about fragmentation; no fragmentation claim is made
